steps.intro: Having bathed and worn a clean dhoti, sit or squat in kukkuṭāsana facing east, with a small vessel of water and an uddharaṇi (spoon). Fold the right palm so that the little, ring and middle fingers are stretched and the index finger is bent inwards, forming a hollow; pour a small amount of water into it and swallow (do not sip) from the brāhma-tīrtha (base of the thumb) with each of the three names, for the purification of body, speech and mind. Then wash the right hand, wipe the lips with the right thumb from right to left, and wash the hand again. Direction: all sources face east in the morning; at noon Kidambi and the Mumbai Smārta text face east while sandhya.pdf says north; in the evening Kidambi and Chakravarthy face east until arghya-pradānam and west thereafter, sandhya.pdf faces west throughout and the Mumbai Smārta text north.

items.action: pour a little water into the right palm and swallow it
items.meaning: Salutations to Acyuta, the unfallen, unchanging one.
Salutations to Ananta, the infinite one.

items.action: again pour water and swallow; then wash the right hand and wipe the lips with the thumb
items.meaning: Salutations to Govinda, protector of the cows and of the earth.

title.en: Touching the limbs with the twelve names

steps.intro: Touch the parts of the body indicated with the fingers of the right hand while saying each name, consecrating the body as the temple of God. In each case the thumb touches the middle of the finger used (Chakravarthy). Together with the three sips this forms one ācamanam.

items.action: right thumb → right cheek (seat of fire)
items.meaning: Salutations to Keśava, of beautiful locks, slayer of the demon Keśī.
Salutations to Nārāyaṇa, the abode and resting place of all beings.

items.action: ring finger → right eye (seat of the Sun)
items.meaning: Salutations to Mādhava, consort of Lakṣmī (Mā).
Salutations to Govinda, protector of the cows and of the earth.

items.action: index finger → right side of the nose (seat of wind)
items.meaning: Salutations to Viṣṇu, the all-pervading.

items.action: index finger → left side of the nose
items.meaning: Salutations to Madhusūdana, slayer of the demon Madhu.

items.action: little finger → right ear (seat of Indra)
items.meaning: Salutations to Trivikrama, who measured the worlds in three strides.
Salutations to Vāmana, the dwarf incarnation.

items.action: middle finger → right shoulder (seat of Prajāpati)
items.meaning: Salutations to Śrīdhara, bearer of Śrī on His chest.
Salutations to Hṛṣīkeśa, lord of the senses.

items.action: all fingers of the right hand → navel
items.meaning: Salutations to Padmanābha, from whose navel the lotus (of creation) springs.

items.action: all fingers of the right hand → top of the head
items.meaning: Salutations to Dāmodara, who was bound with a rope (dāma) around the waist by Yaśodā.

items.text: Kidambi: this whole ācamanam (three sips and the twelve names) is performed twice.

steps.intro: Gently tap both temples with the knuckles (five times in all, once after each phrase marked in the verse), with the thought that the spiritual nectar collected there is spreading through the body. Kidambi's Śrī Vaiṣṇava text omits this step; the Chakravarthy text notes that *viṣṇum* here refers to Gaṇapati (the obstacle-remover).

items.meaning: The all-pervading Lord Viṣṇu is to be meditated upon for the removal of all obstacles — clad in white garments, resplendent like the moon, four-armed and cheerful-faced.

steps.intro: Sit erect. Fold the index and middle fingers of the right hand into the palm; the thumb closes the right nostril and the ring and little fingers the left. Close the left nostril and breathe out slowly through the right; close the right nostril, open the left and breathe in fully; then close both nostrils and, with mouth and eyes closed, recite the mantra mentally while holding the breath; open the right nostril and breathe out slowly. Chakravarthy: recite the seven vyāhṛtis while inhaling, the Gāyatrī while holding, and *oṃ āpo jyotī…* while exhaling (ratio 1:3:2). This is one prāṇāyāma; do three. The left hand rests palm-up on the left thigh (thumb and index touching).

text.iast:
oṃ bhūḥ | oṃ bhuvaḥ | oguṃ suvaḥ | oṃ mahaḥ | oṃ janaḥ | oṃ tapaḥ | oguṃ sa̱tyam |
oṃ tat sa̍vi̱tur vare̎ṇya̱ṃ bhargo̍ de̱vasya̍ dhīmahi | dhiyo̱ yo na̍ḥ praco̱dayā̎t ||
oṃ āpo̱ jyotī̱ raso̱'mṛta̱ṃ brahma̱ bhūr bhuva̱s suva̱rom ||
text.devanagari:
ॐ भूः । ॐ भुवः । ओगुं सुवः । ॐ महः । ॐ जनः । ॐ तपः । ओगुं स॒त्यम् ।
ॐ तत् स॑वि॒तुर् वरे᳚ण्यं॒ भर्गो॑ दे॒वस्य॑ धीमहि । धियो॒ यो नः॑ प्रचो॒दया᳚त् ॥
ॐ आपो॒ ज्योती॒ रसो॒ऽमृतं॒ ब्रह्म॒ भूर् भुव॒स् सुव॒रोम् ॥
text.tamil:
ௐ பூ⁴ஃ । ௐ பு⁴வஃ । ஓகு³ம் ஸுவஃ । ௐ மஹஃ । ௐ ஜனஃ । ௐ தபஃ । ஓகு³ம் ஸ॒த்யம் ।
ௐ தத் ஸ॑வி॒துர் வரே᳚ண்யம்॒ ப⁴ர்கோ॑³ தே॒³வஸ்ய॑ தீ⁴மஹி । தி⁴யோ॒ யோ ந॑ஃ ப்ரசோ॒த³யா᳚த் ॥
ௐ ஆபோ॒ ஜ்யோதீ॒ ரஸோ॒(அ)ம்ருதம்॒ ப்³ரஹ்ம॒ பூ⁴ர் பு⁴வ॒ஸ் ஸுவ॒ரோம் ॥
text.kannada:
ಓಂ ಭೂಃ । ಓಂ ಭುವಃ । ಓಗುಂ ಸುವಃ । ಓಂ ಮಹಃ । ಓಂ ಜನಃ । ಓಂ ತಪಃ । ಓಗುಂ ಸ॒ತ್ಯಂ ।
ಓಂ ತತ್ ಸ॑ವಿ॒ತುರ್ ವರೇ᳚ಣ್ಯಂ॒ ಭರ್ಗೋ॑ ದೇ॒ವಸ್ಯ॑ ಧೀಮಹಿ । ಧಿಯೋ॒ ಯೋ ನಃ॑ ಪ್ರಚೋ॒ದಯಾ᳚ತ್ ॥
ಓಂ ಆಪೋ॒ ಜ್ಯೋತೀ॒ ರಸೋ॒ಽಮೃತಂ॒ ಬ್ರಹ್ಮ॒ ಭೂರ್ ಭುವ॒ಸ್ ಸುವ॒ರೋಂ ॥
text.telugu:
ఓం భూః । ఓం భువః । ఓగుం సువః । ఓం మహః । ఓం జనః । ఓం తపః । ఓగుం స॒త్యం ।
ఓం తత్ స॑వి॒తుర్ వరే᳚ణ్యం॒ భర్గో॑ దే॒వస్య॑ ధీమహి । ధియో॒ యో నః॑ ప్రచో॒దయా᳚త్ ॥
ఓం ఆపో॒ జ్యోతీ॒ రసో॒ఽమృతం॒ బ్రహ్మ॒ భూర్ భువ॒స్ సువ॒రోం ॥
text.malayalam:
ഓം ഭൂഃ । ഓം ഭുവഃ । ഓഗും സുവഃ । ഓം മഹഃ । ഓം ജനഃ । ഓം തപഃ । ഓഗും സ॒ത്യം ।
ഓം തത് സ॑വി॒തുർ വരേ᳚ണ്യം॒ ഭർഗോ॑ ദേ॒വസ്യ॑ ധീമഹി । ധിയോ॒ യോ നഃ॑ പ്രചോ॒ദയാ᳚ത് ॥
ഓം ആപോ॒ ജ്യോതീ॒ രസോ॒ഽമൃതം॒ ബ്രഹ്മ॒ ഭൂർ ഭുവ॒സ് സുവ॒രോം ॥

items.action: recite mentally while holding the breath (three prāṇāyāmas)
items.meaning: Om — the material world; Om — the realm of mind; Om — the realm of light; Om — the realm of vastness; Om — the realm of creative delight; Om — the realm of unobstructed will; Om — the realm of the highest Truth. May we meditate upon that adorable light of the divine Creator; may He impel our intellect. He is in the waters, in light, in flavour, in the nectar of immortality; He pervades the three realms — physical, mental and spiritual. All this is denoted by the Praṇava.

items.text: Then touch the right ear with the fingers of the right hand (śrotrācamanam — Gaṅgā resides in the right ear), and make brahmāñjali: left palm upturned on the right thigh, right palm downturned clasping it. This is also the saṅkalpa posture.

steps.intro: In the saṅkalpa posture (left palm upturned on the right thigh, right palm covering it), state the intent for this sandhyā. Smārtas use the *mamopātta…* form, Śrī Vaiṣṇavas the *śrī bhagavadājñayā…* form. If detailed saṅkalpam is switched on, the day's pañcāṅga (year, ayana, ṛtu, month, pakṣa, tithi, vāra, nakṣatra) is inserted before the kāla. Afterwards wash the right palm with water (Chakravarthy).

text.iast: hariḥ oṃ tatsat | govinda govinda govinda | mamopātta samasta duritakṣaya dvārā śrī parameśvara prītyarthaṃ {panchanga}{kala} sandhyām upāsiṣye ||

items.meaning: Hari, Om, That is the Truth. Govinda, Govinda, Govinda. For the destruction of all the sins I have accumulated and to please the Supreme Lord, I now perform my {kalaEn} sandhyā worship.

items.text: The Mumbai Smārta text words the noon saṅkalpa as *…prītyarthaṃ mādhyāhnikaṃ kariṣye*.

items.meaning: Hari, Om, That is the Truth. Govinda, Govinda, Govinda. By the command of the Lord and to please Śrīman Nārāyaṇa, I now perform my {kalaEn} sandhyā worship.

items.text: sandhya.pdf gives the Vaiṣṇava saṅkalpa as *bhagavad ājñayā bhagavat kaiṅkarya rūpaṃ {kala} sandhyām upāsiṣye* (as service to Him); some combine both: *śrī bhagavadājñayā bhagavat kaiṅkarya rūpaṃ śrīmannārāyaṇa prītyarthaṃ*.

title.en: Dedication of the act to the Lord (opening)

steps.intro: With both hands in añjali mudrā (namaste), surrender the agency and fruit of the act to the Lord: He, the indweller, causes this sandhyāvandanam to be done through you, with His own instruments, for His own pleasure.

text.iast: bhagavāneva svaniyāmya svarūpasthiti pravṛtti svaśeṣataika rasena anena ātmanā kartrā svakīyaiśca upakaraṇaiḥ svārādhanaika prayojanāya paramapuruṣaḥ sarvaśeṣī śriyaḥ patiḥ svaśeṣabhūtaṃ idaṃ {kala} sandhyāvandanākhyaṃ karma svasmai svaprītaye svayameva kārayati ||
text.devanagari: भगवानेव स्वनियाम्य स्वरूपस्थिति प्रवृत्ति स्वशेषतैक रसेन अनेन आत्मना कर्त्रा स्वकीयैश्च उपकरणैः स्वाराधनैक प्रयोजनाय परमपुरुषः सर्वशेषी श्रियः पतिः स्वशेषभूतं इदं {kala} सन्ध्यावन्दनाख्यं कर्म स्वस्मै स्वप्रीतये स्वयमेव कारयति ॥
text.tamil: ப⁴க³வானேவ ஸ்வனியாம்ய ஸ்வரூபஸ்தி²தி ப்ரவ்ருத்தி ஸ்வஶேஷதைக ரஸேன அனேன ஆத்மனா கர்த்ரா ஸ்வகீயைஶ்ச உபகரணைஃ ஸ்வாராத⁴னைக ப்ரயோஜனாய பரமபுருஷஃ ஸர்வஶேஷீ ஶ்ரியஃ பதிஃ ஸ்வஶேஷபூ⁴தம் இத³ம் {kala} ஸந்த்⁴யாவந்த³னாக்²யம் கர்ம ஸ்வஸ்மை ஸ்வப்ரீதயே ஸ்வயமேவ காரயதி ॥
text.kannada: ಭಗವಾನೇವ ಸ್ವನಿಯಾಮ್ಯ ಸ್ವರೂಪಸ್ಥಿತಿ ಪ್ರವೃತ್ತಿ ಸ್ವಶೇಷತೈಕ ರಸೇನ ಅನೇನ ಆತ್ಮನಾ ಕರ್ತ್ರಾ ಸ್ವಕೀಯೈಶ್ಚ ಉಪಕರಣೈಃ ಸ್ವಾರಾಧನೈಕ ಪ್ರಯೋಜನಾಯ ಪರಮಪುರುಷಃ ಸರ್ವಶೇಷೀ ಶ್ರಿಯಃ ಪತಿಃ ಸ್ವಶೇಷಭೂತಂ ಇದಂ {kala} ಸಂಧ್ಯಾವಂದನಾಖ್ಯಂ ಕರ್ಮ ಸ್ವಸ್ಮೈ ಸ್ವಪ್ರೀತಯೇ ಸ್ವಯಮೇವ ಕಾರಯತಿ ॥
text.telugu: భగవానేవ స్వనియామ్య స్వరూపస్థితి ప్రవృత్తి స్వశేషతైక రసేన అనేన ఆత్మనా కర్త్రా స్వకీయైశ్చ ఉపకరణైః స్వారాధనైక ప్రయోజనాయ పరమపురుషః సర్వశేషీ శ్రియః పతిః స్వశేషభూతం ఇదం {kala} సంధ్యావందనాఖ్యం కర్మ స్వస్మై స్వప్రీతయే స్వయమేవ కారయతి ॥
text.malayalam: ഭഗവാനേവ സ്വനിയാമ്യ സ്വരൂപസ്ഥിതി പ്രവൃത്തി സ്വശേഷതൈക രസേന അനേന ആത്മനാ കർത്രാ സ്വകീയൈശ്ച ഉപകരണൈഃ സ്വാരാധനൈക പ്രയോജനായ പരമപുരുഷഃ സർവശേഷീ ശ്രിയഃ പതിഃ സ്വശേഷഭൂതം ഇദം {kala} സന്ധ്യാവന്ദനാഖ്യം കർമ സ്വസ്മൈ സ്വപ്രീതയേ സ്വയമേവ കാരയതി ॥

items.meaning: The Lord Himself — the Supreme Person, the master of all, the consort of Śrī — through this self as agent, whose nature, existence and activity are controlled by Him and whose sole delight is being His servant, and with instruments that are His own, for the sole purpose of His own worship, Himself causes this act called the {kalaEn} sandhyāvandanam, which belongs to Him, to be performed for His own sake and for His own pleasure.

items.text: Chakravarthy's wording begins *oṃ bhagavāneva…* and reads *svaśeṣataika rasena mayā svakīyaiśca upakaraṇaiḥ … karma bhagavān svasmai svaprītaye svayameva kārayati*.

steps.intro: If the ūrdhva-puṇḍram or tilakam was not applied after the bath, apply it now: dip the ring finger (sandhya.pdf: middle finger) in water from the vessel, trace *oṃ keśavāya namaḥ* on the water, and apply the mark to the middle of the forehead while reciting.

items.action: apply the tilakam to the forehead with the wet ring finger
items.meaning: Om, salutations to Śrī Keśava.

steps.intro: Hold the vessel in the left hand; take a little water in the right palm (or on the ring finger from the uddharaṇi) and sprinkle it on the head with the fingers of the right hand, once with each line. Nyāsa first: touch the top of the head while naming the ṛṣi, the tip of the nose for the chandas, the heart for the devatā, and join the palms in añjali for the viniyoga (Kidambi, Chakravarthy; the srimatham, Mumbai and Kaalai Smārta texts omit the nyāsa).

text.iast: āpo hiṣṭheti mantrasya sindhudvīpa ṛṣiḥ | devī gāyatrī chandaḥ | āpo devatā | apāṃ prokṣaṇe viniyogaḥ ||
text.devanagari: आपो हिष्ठेति मन्त्रस्य सिन्धुद्वीप ऋषिः । देवी गायत्री छन्दः । आपो देवता । अपां प्रोक्षणे विनियोगः ॥
text.tamil: ஆபோ ஹிஷ்டே²தி மந்த்ரஸ்ய ஸிந்து⁴த்³வீப ருஷிஃ । தே³வீ கா³யத்ரீ ச²ந்த³ஃ । ஆபோ தே³வதா । அபாம் ப்ரோக்ஷணே விநியோக³ஃ ॥
text.kannada: ಆಪೋ ಹಿಷ್ಠೇತಿ ಮಂತ್ರಸ್ಯ ಸಿಂಧುದ್ವೀಪ ಋಷಿಃ । ದೇವೀ ಗಾಯತ್ರೀ ಛಂದಃ । ಆಪೋ ದೇವತಾ । ಅಪಾಂ ಪ್ರೋಕ್ಷಣೇ ವಿನಿಯೋಗಃ ॥
text.telugu: ఆపో హిష్ఠేతి మంత్రస్య సింధుద్వీప ఋషిః । దేవీ గాయత్రీ ఛందః । ఆపో దేవతా । అపాం ప్రోక్షణే వినియోగః ॥
text.malayalam: ആപോ ഹിഷ്ഠേതി മന്ത്രസ്യ സിന്ധുദ്വീപ ഋഷിഃ । ദേവീ ഗായത്രീ ഛന്ദഃ । ആപോ ദേവതാ । അപാം പ്രോക്ഷണേ വിനിയോഗഃ ॥

items.action: nyāsa: touch head (ṛṣi), tip of nose (chandas), heart (devatā); then añjali (viniyoga)
items.meaning: Of the mantra *āpo hiṣṭhā*, Sindhudvīpa is the seer, devī gāyatrī the metre, the Waters the deity; it is applied in the sprinkling of water.

text.iast:
oṃ bhūr bhuva̱s suva̍ḥ |
tat sa̍vi̱tur vare̎ṇya̱ṃ bhargo̍ de̱vasya̍ dhīmahi |
dhiyo̱ yo na̍ḥ praco̱dayā̎t ||
text.devanagari:
ॐ भूर् भुव॒स् सुवः॑ ।
तत् स॑वि॒तुर् वरे᳚ण्यं॒ भर्गो॑ दे॒वस्य॑ धीमहि ।
धियो॒ यो नः॑ प्रचो॒दया᳚त् ॥
text.tamil:
ௐ பூ⁴ர் பு⁴வ॒ஸ் ஸுவ॑ஃ ।
தத் ஸ॑வி॒துர் வரே᳚ண்யம்॒ ப⁴ர்கோ॑³ தே॒³வஸ்ய॑ தீ⁴மஹி ।
தி⁴யோ॒ யோ ந॑ஃ ப்ரசோ॒த³யா᳚த் ॥
text.kannada:
ಓಂ ಭೂರ್ ಭುವ॒ಸ್ ಸುವಃ॑ ।
ತತ್ ಸ॑ವಿ॒ತುರ್ ವರೇ᳚ಣ್ಯಂ॒ ಭರ್ಗೋ॑ ದೇ॒ವಸ್ಯ॑ ಧೀಮಹಿ ।
ಧಿಯೋ॒ ಯೋ ನಃ॑ ಪ್ರಚೋ॒ದಯಾ᳚ತ್ ॥
text.telugu:
ఓం భూర్ భువ॒స్ సువః॑ ।
తత్ స॑వి॒తుర్ వరే᳚ణ్యం॒ భర్గో॑ దే॒వస్య॑ ధీమహి ।
ధియో॒ యో నః॑ ప్రచో॒దయా᳚త్ ॥
text.malayalam:
ഓം ഭൂർ ഭുവ॒സ് സുവഃ॑ ।
തത് സ॑വി॒തുർ വരേ᳚ണ്യം॒ ഭർഗോ॑ ദേ॒വസ്യ॑ ധീമഹി ।
ധിയോ॒ യോ നഃ॑ പ്രചോ॒ദയാ᳚ത് ॥

items.action: prelude (Kidambi): sprinkle on the head three times, once with each line
items.meaning: Om, earth, atmosphere, heaven. May we meditate upon that adorable light of the divine Savitṛ; may He impel our thoughts.

text.iast:
āpo̱ hiṣṭhā ma̍yo̱ bhuva̱ḥ | tā na̍ ū̱rje da̍dhātana | ma̱he raṇā̍ya̱ cakṣa̍se |
yo va̍ś śi̱vata̍mo̱ rasa̱ḥ | tasya̍ bhājayate̱ha naḥ | u̱śa̱tīri̍va mā̱taraḥ |
tasmā̱ ara̍ṅga māma vaḥ |
text.devanagari:
आपो॒ हिष्ठा म॑यो॒ भुवः॒ । ता न॑ ऊ॒र्जे द॑धातन । म॒हे रणा॑य॒ चक्ष॑से ।
यो व॑श् शि॒वत॑मो॒ रसः॒ । तस्य॑ भाजयते॒ह नः । उ॒श॒तीरि॑व मा॒तरः ।
तस्मा॒ अर॑ङ्ग माम वः ।
text.tamil:
ஆபோ॒ ஹிஷ்டா² ம॑யோ॒ பு⁴வ॒ஃ । தா ந॑ ஊ॒ர்ஜே த॑³தா⁴தன । ம॒ஹே ரணா॑ய॒ சக்ஷ॑ஸே ।
யோ வ॑ஶ் ஶி॒வத॑மோ॒ ரஸ॒ஃ । தஸ்ய॑ பா⁴ஜயதே॒ஹ நஃ । உ॒ஶ॒தீரி॑வ மா॒தரஃ ।
தஸ்மா॒ அர॑ங்க³ மாம வஃ ।
text.kannada:
ಆಪೋ॒ ಹಿಷ್ಠಾ ಮ॑ಯೋ॒ ಭುವಃ॒ । ತಾ ನ॑ ಊ॒ರ್ಜೇ ದ॑ಧಾತನ । ಮ॒ಹೇ ರಣಾ॑ಯ॒ ಚಕ್ಷ॑ಸೇ ।
ಯೋ ವ॑ಶ್ ಶಿ॒ವತ॑ಮೋ॒ ರಸಃ॒ । ತಸ್ಯ॑ ಭಾಜಯತೇ॒ಹ ನಃ । ಉ॒ಶ॒ತೀರಿ॑ವ ಮಾ॒ತರಃ ।
ತಸ್ಮಾ॒ ಅರಂ॑ಗ ಮಾಮ ವಃ ।
text.telugu:
ఆపో॒ హిష్ఠా మ॑యో॒ భువః॒ । తా న॑ ఊ॒ర్జే ద॑ధాతన । మ॒హే రణా॑య॒ చక్ష॑సే ।
యో వ॑శ్ శి॒వత॑మో॒ రసః॒ । తస్య॑ భాజయతే॒హ నః । ఉ॒శ॒తీరి॑వ మా॒తరః ।
తస్మా॒ అరం॑గ మామ వః ।
text.malayalam:
ആപോ॒ ഹിഷ്ഠാ മ॑യോ॒ ഭുവഃ॒ । താ ന॑ ഊ॒ർജേ ദ॑ധാതന । മ॒ഹേ രണാ॑യ॒ ചക്ഷ॑സേ ।
യോ വ॑ശ് ശി॒വത॑മോ॒ രസഃ॒ । തസ്യ॑ ഭാജയതേ॒ഹ നഃ । ഉ॒ശ॒തീരി॑വ മാ॒തരഃ ।
തസ്മാ॒ അരം॑ഗ മാമ വഃ ।

items.action: sprinkle on the head once with each of these seven lines
items.meaning: O Waters, you are indeed the source of bliss; grant us nourishment, that we may behold great delight. Grant us here a share of that most auspicious essence of yours, like mothers in their tender love. To Him we come gladly, (to whose abode you lead us).

items.action: sprinkle on the feet (Kidambi: knees; Chakravarthy: big toes)
items.meaning: …for whose abode you quicken us.
O Waters, make us pure and grant us to be reborn with splendour.

items.action: take a little water in the palm and circle it around the head clockwise, sprinkling it around yourself
items.meaning: Om, earth, atmosphere, heaven.

steps.intro: Nyāsa as before (head – nose – heart – añjali). Then pour a small amount of water into the hollow of the right palm, recite the mantra for the kāla, and swallow (do not sip) the water from the brahma-tīrtha. Afterwards perform ācamanam.

text.iast: sūryaścety anuvākasya agnir ṛṣiḥ | devī gāyatrī chandaḥ | sūryo devatā | apāṃ prāśane viniyogaḥ ||
text.devanagari: सूर्यश्चेत्य् अनुवाकस्य अग्निर् ऋषिः । देवी गायत्री छन्दः । सूर्यो देवता । अपां प्राशने विनियोगः ॥
text.tamil: ஸூர்யஶ்சேத்ய் அனுவாகஸ்ய அக்³நிர் ருஷிஃ । தே³வீ கா³யத்ரீ ச²ந்த³ஃ । ஸூர்யோ தே³வதா । அபாம் ப்ராஶனே விநியோக³ஃ ॥
text.kannada: ಸೂರ್ಯಶ್ಚೇತ್ಯ್ ಅನುವಾಕಸ್ಯ ಅಗ್ನಿರ್ ಋಷಿಃ । ದೇವೀ ಗಾಯತ್ರೀ ಛಂದಃ । ಸೂರ್ಯೋ ದೇವತಾ । ಅಪಾಂ ಪ್ರಾಶನೇ ವಿನಿಯೋಗಃ ॥
text.telugu: సూర్యశ్చేత్య్ అనువాకస్య అగ్నిర్ ఋషిః । దేవీ గాయత్రీ ఛందః । సూర్యో దేవతా । అపాం ప్రాశనే వినియోగః ॥
text.malayalam: സൂര്യശ്ചേത്യ് അനുവാകസ്യ അഗ്നിർ ഋഷിഃ । ദേവീ ഗായത്രീ ഛന്ദഃ । സൂര്യോ ദേവതാ । അപാം പ്രാശനേ വിനിയോഗഃ ॥

items.action: nyāsa: touch head (ṛṣi), tip of nose (chandas), heart (devatā); then añjali (viniyoga)
items.meaning: Of the anuvāka beginning *sūryaśca*, Agni is the seer, devī gāyatrī the metre, Sūrya the deity; it is applied in the sipping of water.

text.iast: sūryaśca mā manyuśca manyupatayaśca manyu̍kṛte̱bhyaḥ | pāpebhyo̍ rakṣa̱ntām | yad rātriyā pāpa̍m akā̱rṣam | manasā vācā̍ hastā̱bhyām | padbhyām udare̍ṇa śi̱śnā | rātri̱s tad ava̍lu̱mpatu | yat kiñca̍ duri̱taṃ mayi̍ | idam ahaṃ mām amṛ̍ta yo̱nau | sūrye jyotiṣi juho̍mi svā̱hā ||
text.devanagari: सूर्यश्च मा मन्युश्च मन्युपतयश्च मन्यु॑कृते॒भ्यः । पापेभ्यो॑ रक्ष॒न्ताम् । यद् रात्रिया पाप॑म् अका॒र्षम् । मनसा वाचा॑ हस्ता॒भ्याम् । पद्भ्याम् उदरे॑ण शि॒श्ना । रात्रि॒स् तद् अव॑लु॒म्पतु । यत् किञ्च॑ दुरि॒तं मयि॑ । इदम् अहं माम् अमृ॑त यो॒नौ । सूर्ये ज्योतिषि जुहो॑मि स्वा॒हा ॥
text.tamil: ஸூர்யஶ்ச மா மன்யுஶ்ச மன்யுபதயஶ்ச மன்யு॑க்ருதே॒ப்⁴யஃ । பாபேப்⁴யோ॑ ரக்ஷ॒ந்தாம் । யத்³ ராத்ரியா பாப॑ம் அகா॒ர்ஷம் । மனஸா வாசா॑ ஹஸ்தா॒ப்⁴யாம் । பத்³ப்⁴யாம் உத³ரே॑ண ஶி॒ஶ்னா । ராத்ரி॒ஸ் தத்³ அவ॑லு॒ம்பது । யத் கிஞ்ச॑ து³ரி॒தம் மயி॑ । இத³ம் அஹம் மாம் அம்ரு॑த யோ॒னௌ । ஸூர்யே ஜ்யோதிஷி ஜுஹோ॑மி ஸ்வா॒ஹா ॥
text.kannada: ಸೂರ್ಯಶ್ಚ ಮಾ ಮನ್ಯುಶ್ಚ ಮನ್ಯುಪತಯಶ್ಚ ಮನ್ಯು॑ಕೃತೇ॒ಭ್ಯಃ । ಪಾಪೇಭ್ಯೋ॑ ರಕ್ಷಂ॒ತಾಂ । ಯದ್ ರಾತ್ರಿಯಾ ಪಾಪಂ॑ ಅಕಾ॒ರ್ಷಂ । ಮನಸಾ ವಾಚಾ॑ ಹಸ್ತಾ॒ಭ್ಯಾಂ । ಪದ್ಭ್ಯಾಂ ಉದರೇ॑ಣ ಶಿ॒ಶ್ನಾ । ರಾತ್ರಿ॒ಸ್ ತದ್ ಅವ॑ಲುಂ॒ಪತು । ಯತ್ ಕಿಂಚ॑ ದುರಿ॒ತಂ ಮಯಿ॑ । ಇದಂ ಅಹಂ ಮಾಂ ಅಮೃ॑ತ ಯೋ॒ನೌ । ಸೂರ್ಯೇ ಜ್ಯೋತಿಷಿ ಜುಹೋ॑ಮಿ ಸ್ವಾ॒ಹಾ ॥
text.telugu: సూర్యశ్చ మా మన్యుశ్చ మన్యుపతయశ్చ మన్యు॑కృతే॒భ్యః । పాపేభ్యో॑ రక్షం॒తాం । యద్ రాత్రియా పాపం॑ అకా॒ర్షం । మనసా వాచా॑ హస్తా॒భ్యాం । పద్భ్యాం ఉదరే॑ణ శి॒శ్నా । రాత్రి॒స్ తద్ అవ॑లుం॒పతు । యత్ కించ॑ దురి॒తం మయి॑ । ఇదం అహం మాం అమృ॑త యో॒నౌ । సూర్యే జ్యోతిషి జుహో॑మి స్వా॒హా ॥
text.malayalam: സൂര്യശ്ച മാ മന്യുശ്ച മന്യുപതയശ്ച മന്യു॑കൃതേ॒ഭ്യഃ । പാപേഭ്യോ॑ രക്ഷ॒ന്താം । യദ് രാത്രിയാ പാപം॑ അകാ॒ർഷം । മനസാ വാചാ॑ ഹസ്താ॒ഭ്യാം । പദ്ഭ്യാം ഉദരേ॑ണ ശി॒ശ്നാ । രാത്രി॒സ് തദ് അവ॑ലു॒മ്പതു । യത് കിഞ്ച॑ ദുരി॒തം മയി॑ । ഇദം അഹം മാം അമൃ॑ത യോ॒നൗ । സൂര്യേ ജ്യോതിഷി ജുഹോ॑മി സ്വാ॒ഹാ ॥

items.action: recite with the water in the right palm, then swallow it
items.meaning: May the Sun, anger, the lords of anger and (the deities presiding over) the sins born of anger protect me. Whatever sin I have committed by night — by thought, speech, hands, feet, belly or organ — may the night efface it. Whatever evil remains in me, I offer myself as an oblation into the Sun, the source of immortality, the Light. Svāhā.

text.iast: āpaḥ punantv ity anuvākasya āpa ṛṣiḥ | anuṣṭup chandaḥ | brahmaṇaspatir devatā | apāṃ prāśane viniyogaḥ ||
text.devanagari: आपः पुनन्त्व् इत्य् अनुवाकस्य आप ऋषिः । अनुष्टुप् छन्दः । ब्रह्मणस्पतिर् देवता । अपां प्राशने विनियोगः ॥
text.tamil: ஆபஃ புனந்த்வ் இத்ய் அனுவாகஸ்ய ஆப ருஷிஃ । அனுஷ்டுப் ச²ந்த³ஃ । ப்³ரஹ்மணஸ்பதிர் தே³வதா । அபாம் ப்ராஶனே விநியோக³ஃ ॥
text.kannada: ಆಪಃ ಪುನಂತ್ವ್ ಇತ್ಯ್ ಅನುವಾಕಸ್ಯ ಆಪ ಋಷಿಃ । ಅನುಷ್ಟುಪ್ ಛಂದಃ । ಬ್ರಹ್ಮಣಸ್ಪತಿರ್ ದೇವತಾ । ಅಪಾಂ ಪ್ರಾಶನೇ ವಿನಿಯೋಗಃ ॥
text.telugu: ఆపః పునంత్వ్ ఇత్య్ అనువాకస్య ఆప ఋషిః । అనుష్టుప్ ఛందః । బ్రహ్మణస్పతిర్ దేవతా । అపాం ప్రాశనే వినియోగః ॥
text.malayalam: ആപഃ പുനന്ത്വ് ഇത്യ് അനുവാകസ്യ ആപ ഋഷിഃ । അനുഷ്ടുപ് ഛന്ദഃ । ബ്രഹ്മണസ്പതിർ ദേവതാ । അപാം പ്രാശനേ വിനിയോഗഃ ॥

items.action: nyāsa: touch head (ṛṣi), tip of nose (chandas), heart (devatā); then añjali (viniyoga)
items.meaning: Of the anuvāka beginning *āpaḥ punantu*, the Waters are the seer, anuṣṭup the metre, Brahmaṇaspati the deity; it is applied in the sipping of water.

text.iast: āpa̍ḥ punantu pṛthi̱vīṃ pṛ̍thi̱vī pū̱tā pu̍nātu̱ mām | pu̱nantu̱ brahma̍ṇa̱spati̱r brahma̍ pū̱tā pu̍nātu̱ mām | yad ucchi̍ṣṭam abho̎jya̱ṃ yad vā̍ du̱ścari̍ta̱ṃ mama̍ | sarva̍ṃ punantu̱ mām āpo̍'sa̱tāṃ ca̍ prati̱graha̱guṃ svāhā̎ ||
text.devanagari: आपः॑ पुनन्तु पृथि॒वीं पृ॑थि॒वी पू॒ता पु॑नातु॒ माम् । पु॒नन्तु॒ ब्रह्म॑ण॒स्पति॒र् ब्रह्म॑ पू॒ता पु॑नातु॒ माम् । यद् उच्छि॑ष्टम् अभो᳚ज्यं॒ यद् वा॑ दु॒श्चरि॑तं॒ मम॑ । सर्वं॑ पुनन्तु॒ माम् आपो᳚स॒तां च॑ प्रति॒ग्रह॒गुं स्वाहा᳚ ॥
text.tamil: ஆப॑ஃ புனந்து ப்ருதி॒²வீம் ப்ரு॑தி॒²வீ பூ॒தா பு॑னாது॒ மாம் । பு॒னந்து॒ ப்³ரஹ்ம॑ண॒ஸ்பதி॒ர் ப்³ரஹ்ம॑ பூ॒தா பு॑னாது॒ மாம் । யத்³ உச்சி॑²ஷ்டம் அபோ᳚⁴ஜ்யம்॒ யத்³ வா॑ து॒³ஶ்சரி॑தம்॒ மம॑ । ஸர்வம்॑ புனந்து॒ மாம் ஆபோ᳚ஸ॒தாம் ச॑ ப்ரதி॒க்³ரஹ॒கு³ம் ஸ்வாஹா᳚ ॥
text.kannada: ಆಪಃ॑ ಪುನಂತು ಪೃಥಿ॒ವೀಂ ಪೃ॑ಥಿ॒ವೀ ಪೂ॒ತಾ ಪು॑ನಾತು॒ ಮಾಂ । ಪು॒ನಂತು॒ ಬ್ರಹ್ಮ॑ಣ॒ಸ್ಪತಿ॒ರ್ ಬ್ರಹ್ಮ॑ ಪೂ॒ತಾ ಪು॑ನಾತು॒ ಮಾಂ । ಯದ್ ಉಚ್ಛಿ॑ಷ್ಟಂ ಅಭೋ᳚ಜ್ಯಂ॒ ಯದ್ ವಾ॑ ದು॒ಶ್ಚರಿ॑ತಂ॒ ಮಮ॑ । ಸರ್ವಂ॑ ಪುನಂತು॒ ಮಾಂ ಆಪೋ᳚ಸ॒ತಾಂ ಚ॑ ಪ್ರತಿ॒ಗ್ರಹ॒ಗುಂ ಸ್ವಾಹಾ᳚ ॥
text.telugu: ఆపః॑ పునంతు పృథి॒వీం పృ॑థి॒వీ పూ॒తా పు॑నాతు॒ మాం । పు॒నంతు॒ బ్రహ్మ॑ణ॒స్పతి॒ర్ బ్రహ్మ॑ పూ॒తా పు॑నాతు॒ మాం । యద్ ఉచ్ఛి॑ష్టం అభో᳚జ్యం॒ యద్ వా॑ దు॒శ్చరి॑తం॒ మమ॑ । సర్వం॑ పునంతు॒ మాం ఆపో᳚స॒తాం చ॑ ప్రతి॒గ్రహ॒గుం స్వాహా᳚ ॥
text.malayalam: ആപഃ॑ പുനന്തു പൃഥി॒വീം പൃ॑ഥി॒വീ പൂ॒താ പു॑നാതു॒ മാം । പു॒നന്തു॒ ബ്രഹ്മ॑ണ॒സ്പതി॒ർ ബ്രഹ്മ॑ പൂ॒താ പു॑നാതു॒ മാം । യദ് ഉച്ഛി॑ഷ്ടം അഭോ᳚ജ്യം॒ യദ് വാ॑ ദു॒ശ്ചരി॑തം॒ മമ॑ । സർവം॑ പുനന്തു॒ മാം ആപോ᳚സ॒താം ച॑ പ്രതി॒ഗ്രഹ॒ഗും സ്വാഹാ᳚ ॥

items.action: recite with the water in the right palm, then swallow it
items.meaning: May the waters purify the earth; may the purified earth purify me. May the Lord of prayer purify me; may the purified Veda purify me. Whatever remnant I have eaten, whatever forbidden food, whatever misdeed of mine, whatever gift accepted from the unworthy — may the waters purify me of all. Svāhā.

text.iast: agniścety anuvākasya sūrya ṛṣiḥ | devī gāyatrī chandaḥ | agnir devatā | apāṃ prāśane viniyogaḥ ||
text.devanagari: अग्निश्चेत्य् अनुवाकस्य सूर्य ऋषिः । देवी गायत्री छन्दः । अग्निर् देवता । अपां प्राशने विनियोगः ॥
text.tamil: அக்³நிஶ்சேத்ய் அனுவாகஸ்ய ஸூர்ய ருஷிஃ । தே³வீ கா³யத்ரீ ச²ந்த³ஃ । அக்³நிர் தே³வதா । அபாம் ப்ராஶனே விநியோக³ஃ ॥

text.telugu: అగ్నిశ్చేత్య్ అనువాకస్య సూర్య ఋషిః । దేవీ గాయత్రీ ఛందః । అగ్నిర్ దేవతా । అపాం ప్రాశనే వినియోగః ॥
text.malayalam: അഗ്നിശ്ചേത്യ് അനുവാകസ്യ സൂര്യ ഋഷിഃ । ദേവീ ഗായത്രീ ഛന്ദഃ । അഗ്നിർ ദേവതാ । അപാം പ്രാശനേ വിനിയോഗഃ ॥

items.action: nyāsa: touch head (ṛṣi), tip of nose (chandas), heart (devatā); then añjali (viniyoga)
items.meaning: Of the anuvāka beginning *agniśca*, Sūrya is the seer, devī gāyatrī the metre, Agni the deity; it is applied in the sipping of water.

text.kannada: ಅಗ್ನಿಶ್ಚ ಮಾ ಮನ್ಯುಶ್ಚ ಮನ್ಯುಪತಯಶ್ಚ ಮನ್ಯು॑ಕೃತೇ॒ಭ್ಯಃ । ಪಾಪೇಭ್ಯೋ॑ ರಕ್ಷಂ॒ತಾಂ । ಯದ್ ಅಹ್ನಾ ಪಾಪಂ॑ ಅಕಾ॒ರ್ಷಂ । ಮನಸಾ ವಾಚಾ॑ ಹಸ್ತಾ॒ಭ್ಯಾಂ । ಪದ್ಭ್ಯಾಂ ಉದರೇ॑ಣ ಶಿ॒ಶ್ನಾ । ಅಹ॒ಸ್ ತದ್ ಅವ॑ಲುಂ॒ಪತು । ಯತ್ ಕಿಂಚ॑ ದುರಿ॒ತಂ ಮಯಿ॑ । ಇದಂ ಅಹಂ ಮಾಂ ಅಮೃ॑ತ ಯೋ॒ನೌ । ಸತ್ಯೇ ಜ್ಯೋತಿಷಿ ಜುಹೋ॑ಮಿ ಸ್ವಾ॒ಹಾ ॥
text.telugu: అగ్నిశ్చ మా మన్యుశ్చ మన్యుపతయశ్చ మన్యు॑కృతే॒భ్యః । పాపేభ్యో॑ రక్షం॒తాం । యద్ అహ్నా పాపం॑ అకా॒ర్షం । మనసా వాచా॑ హస్తా॒భ్యాం । పద్భ్యాం ఉదరే॑ణ శి॒శ్నా । అహ॒స్ తద్ అవ॑లుం॒పతు । యత్ కించ॑ దురి॒తం మయి॑ । ఇదం అహం మాం అమృ॑త యో॒నౌ । సత్యే జ్యోతిషి జుహో॑మి స్వా॒హా ॥
text.malayalam: അഗ്നിശ്ച മാ മന്യുശ്ച മന്യുപതയശ്ച മന്യു॑കൃതേ॒ഭ്യഃ । പാപേഭ്യോ॑ രക്ഷ॒ന്താം । യദ് അഹ്നാ പാപം॑ അകാ॒ർഷം । മനസാ വാചാ॑ ഹസ്താ॒ഭ്യാം । പദ്ഭ്യാം ഉദരേ॑ണ ശി॒ശ്നാ । അഹ॒സ് തദ് അവ॑ലു॒മ്പതു । യത് കിഞ്ച॑ ദുരി॒തം മയി॑ । ഇദം അഹം മാം അമൃ॑ത യോ॒നൗ । സത്യേ ജ്യോതിഷി ജുഹോ॑മി സ്വാ॒ഹാ ॥

items.action: recite with the water in the right palm, then swallow it
items.meaning: May Agni, anger, the lords of anger and (the deities presiding over) the sins born of anger protect me. Whatever sin I have committed by day — by thought, speech, hands, feet, belly or organ — may the day efface it. Whatever evil remains in me, I offer myself as an oblation into Truth, the source of immortality, the Light. Svāhā.

items.text: Then perform ācamanam (three sips with *acyutāya, anantāya, govindāya namaḥ* and the twelve names).

steps.intro: Nyāsa as before. Then sprinkle water on the head with the *dadhikrāvṇṇo* verse, and repeat the sprinkling with *āpo hiṣṭhā* exactly as in prokṣaṇam.

text.iast: dadhikrāvṇṇa iti mantrasya vāmadeva ṛṣiḥ | anuṣṭup chandaḥ | dadhikrāvā devatā | apāṃ prokṣaṇe viniyogaḥ ||
text.devanagari: दधिक्राव्ण्ण इति मन्त्रस्य वामदेव ऋषिः । अनुष्टुप् छन्दः । दधिक्रावा देवता । अपां प्रोक्षणे विनियोगः ॥
text.tamil: த³தி⁴க்ராவ்ண்ண இதி மந்த்ரஸ்ய வாமதே³வ ருஷிஃ । அனுஷ்டுப் ச²ந்த³ஃ । த³தி⁴க்ராவா தே³வதா । அபாம் ப்ரோக்ஷணே விநியோக³ஃ ॥
text.kannada: ದಧಿಕ್ರಾವ್ಣ್ಣ ಇತಿ ಮಂತ್ರಸ್ಯ ವಾಮದೇವ ಋಷಿಃ । ಅನುಷ್ಟುಪ್ ಛಂದಃ । ದಧಿಕ್ರಾವಾ ದೇವತಾ । ಅಪಾಂ ಪ್ರೋಕ್ಷಣೇ ವಿನಿಯೋಗಃ ॥
text.telugu: దధిక్రావ్ణ్ణ ఇతి మంత్రస్య వామదేవ ఋషిః । అనుష్టుప్ ఛందః । దధిక్రావా దేవతా । అపాం ప్రోక్షణే వినియోగః ॥
text.malayalam: ദധിക്രാവ്ണ്ണ ഇതി മന്ത്രസ്യ വാമദേവ ഋഷിഃ । അനുഷ്ടുപ് ഛന്ദഃ । ദധിക്രാവാ ദേവതാ । അപാം പ്രോക്ഷണേ വിനിയോഗഃ ॥

items.action: nyāsa: touch head (ṛṣi), tip of nose (chandas), heart (devatā); then añjali (viniyoga)
items.meaning: Of the mantra *dadhikrāvṇṇo*, Vāmadeva is the seer, anuṣṭup the metre, Dadhikrāvan the deity; it is applied in the sprinkling of water.

text.iast:
da̱dhi̱krāvṇṇo̍ akāriṣaṃ ji̱ṣṇor aśva̍sya vā̱jina̍ḥ |
su̱ra̱bhi no̱ mukhā̍ kara̱t praṇa̱ āyū̍guṃṣi tāriṣat ||
text.devanagari:
द॒धि॒क्राव्ण्णो॑ अकारिषं जि॒ष्णोर् अश्व॑स्य वा॒जिनः॑ ।
सु॒र॒भि नो॒ मुखा॑ कर॒त् प्रण॒ आयू॑गुंषि तारिषत् ॥
text.tamil:
த॒³தி॒⁴க்ராவ்ண்ணோ॑ அகாரிஷம் ஜி॒ஷ்ணோர் அஶ்வ॑ஸ்ய வா॒ஜின॑ஃ ।
ஸு॒ர॒பி⁴ நோ॒ முகா॑² கர॒த் ப்ரண॒ ஆயூ॑கு³ம்ஷி தாரிஷத் ॥
text.kannada:
ದ॒ಧಿ॒ಕ್ರಾವ್ಣ್ಣೋ॑ ಅಕಾರಿಷಂ ಜಿ॒ಷ್ಣೋರ್ ಅಶ್ವ॑ಸ್ಯ ವಾ॒ಜಿನಃ॑ ।
ಸು॒ರ॒ಭಿ ನೋ॒ ಮುಖಾ॑ ಕರ॒ತ್ ಪ್ರಣ॒ ಆಯೂ॑ಗುಂಷಿ ತಾರಿಷತ್ ॥
text.telugu:
ద॒ధి॒క్రావ్ణ్ణో॑ అకారిషం జి॒ష్ణోర్ అశ్వ॑స్య వా॒జినః॑ ।
సు॒ర॒భి నో॒ ముఖా॑ కర॒త్ ప్రణ॒ ఆయూ॑గుంషి తారిషత్ ॥
text.malayalam:
ദ॒ധി॒ക്രാവ്ണ്ണോ॑ അകാരിഷം ജി॒ഷ്ണോർ അശ്വ॑സ്യ വാ॒ജിനഃ॑ ।
സു॒ര॒ഭി നോ॒ മുഖാ॑ കര॒ത് പ്രണ॒ ആയൂ॑ഗുംഷി താരിഷത് ॥

items.action: sprinkle on the head once with each of the four pādas
items.meaning: I have glorified Dadhikrāvan, the victorious, swift steed (the Lord as Hayagrīva). May He make our mouths fragrant and lengthen our lives. (RV 4.39.6; TS 1.5.11.4)

text.iast:
āpo̱ hiṣṭhā ma̍yo̱ bhuva̱ḥ | tā na̍ ū̱rje da̍dhātana | ma̱he raṇā̍ya̱ cakṣa̍se |
yo va̍ś śi̱vata̍mo̱ rasa̱ḥ | tasya̍ bhājayate̱ha naḥ | u̱śa̱tīri̍va mā̱taraḥ |
tasmā̱ ara̍ṅga māma vaḥ |
text.devanagari:
आपो॒ हिष्ठा म॑यो॒ भुवः॒ । ता न॑ ऊ॒र्जे द॑धातन । म॒हे रणा॑य॒ चक्ष॑से ।
यो व॑श् शि॒वत॑मो॒ रसः॒ । तस्य॑ भाजयते॒ह नः । उ॒श॒तीरि॑व मा॒तरः ।
तस्मा॒ अर॑ङ्ग माम वः ।
text.tamil:
ஆபோ॒ ஹிஷ்டா² ம॑யோ॒ பு⁴வ॒ஃ । தா ந॑ ஊ॒ர்ஜே த॑³தா⁴தன । ம॒ஹே ரணா॑ய॒ சக்ஷ॑ஸே ।
யோ வ॑ஶ் ஶி॒வத॑மோ॒ ரஸ॒ஃ । தஸ்ய॑ பா⁴ஜயதே॒ஹ நஃ । உ॒ஶ॒தீரி॑வ மா॒தரஃ ।
தஸ்மா॒ அர॑ங்க³ மாம வஃ ।
text.kannada:
ಆಪೋ॒ ಹಿಷ್ಠಾ ಮ॑ಯೋ॒ ಭುವಃ॒ । ತಾ ನ॑ ಊ॒ರ್ಜೇ ದ॑ಧಾತನ । ಮ॒ಹೇ ರಣಾ॑ಯ॒ ಚಕ್ಷ॑ಸೇ ।
ಯೋ ವ॑ಶ್ ಶಿ॒ವತ॑ಮೋ॒ ರಸಃ॒ । ತಸ್ಯ॑ ಭಾಜಯತೇ॒ಹ ನಃ । ಉ॒ಶ॒ತೀರಿ॑ವ ಮಾ॒ತರಃ ।
ತಸ್ಮಾ॒ ಅರಂ॑ಗ ಮಾಮ ವಃ ।
text.telugu:
ఆపో॒ హిష్ఠా మ॑యో॒ భువః॒ । తా న॑ ఊ॒ర్జే ద॑ధాతన । మ॒హే రణా॑య॒ చక్ష॑సే ।
యో వ॑శ్ శి॒వత॑మో॒ రసః॒ । తస్య॑ భాజయతే॒హ నః । ఉ॒శ॒తీరి॑వ మా॒తరః ।
తస్మా॒ అరం॑గ మామ వః ।
text.malayalam:
ആപോ॒ ഹിഷ്ഠാ മ॑യോ॒ ഭുവഃ॒ । താ ന॑ ഊ॒ർജേ ദ॑ധാതന । മ॒ഹേ രണാ॑യ॒ ചക്ഷ॑സേ ।
യോ വ॑ശ് ശി॒വത॑മോ॒ രസഃ॒ । തസ്യ॑ ഭാജയതേ॒ഹ നഃ । ഉ॒ശ॒തീരി॑വ മാ॒തരഃ ।
തസ്മാ॒ അരം॑ഗ മാമ വഃ ।

items.action: sprinkle on the head once with each of these seven lines
items.meaning: O Waters, you are indeed the source of bliss; grant us nourishment, that we may behold great delight. Grant us here a share of that most auspicious essence of yours, like mothers in their tender love. To Him we come gladly, (to whose abode you lead us).

items.action: sprinkle on the feet (Kidambi: knees; Chakravarthy: big toes)
items.meaning: …for whose abode you quicken us.
O Waters, make us pure and grant us to be reborn with splendour.

items.action: take a little water in the palm and circle it around the head clockwise, sprinkling it around yourself
items.meaning: Om, earth, atmosphere, heaven.

steps.intro: Perform prāṇāyāma (Chakravarthy: one round), touch the right ear, and take the saṅkalpa posture for the saṅkalpa; then nyāsa. Stand erect (morning and noon facing east; in the evening face west from now on) holding the vessel between the thumb and index finger of the left hand; join both palms facing upwards, pour water into the hollow of the joined palms and raise them to the level of the forehead. Recite the Gāyatrī aloud and, looking towards the sun and rising on the heels, release the water from the fingertips (deva-tīrtha) — thrown up towards the sun (Chakravarthy) or poured on the ground (sandhya.pdf); if standing in a river or tank, offer with cupped palms. Three libations in the morning and evening; at noon two (Mumbai Smārta text, Chakravarthy) — Kidambi gives one, noting a sampradāya of two. Chakravarthy: at noon standing or sitting; in the evening sitting.

text.iast:
oṃ bhūḥ | oṃ bhuvaḥ | oguṃ suvaḥ | oṃ mahaḥ | oṃ janaḥ | oṃ tapaḥ | oguṃ sa̱tyam |
oṃ tat sa̍vi̱tur vare̎ṇya̱ṃ bhargo̍ de̱vasya̍ dhīmahi | dhiyo̱ yo na̍ḥ praco̱dayā̎t ||
oṃ āpo̱ jyotī̱ raso̱'mṛta̱ṃ brahma̱ bhūr bhuva̱s suva̱rom ||
text.devanagari:
ॐ भूः । ॐ भुवः । ओगुं सुवः । ॐ महः । ॐ जनः । ॐ तपः । ओगुं स॒त्यम् ।
ॐ तत् स॑वि॒तुर् वरे᳚ण्यं॒ भर्गो॑ दे॒वस्य॑ धीमहि । धियो॒ यो नः॑ प्रचो॒दया᳚त् ॥
ॐ आपो॒ ज्योती॒ रसो॒ऽमृतं॒ ब्रह्म॒ भूर् भुव॒स् सुव॒रोम् ॥
text.tamil:
ௐ பூ⁴ஃ । ௐ பு⁴வஃ । ஓகு³ம் ஸுவஃ । ௐ மஹஃ । ௐ ஜனஃ । ௐ தபஃ । ஓகு³ம் ஸ॒த்யம் ।
ௐ தத் ஸ॑வி॒துர் வரே᳚ண்யம்॒ ப⁴ர்கோ॑³ தே॒³வஸ்ய॑ தீ⁴மஹி । தி⁴யோ॒ யோ ந॑ஃ ப்ரசோ॒த³யா᳚த் ॥
ௐ ஆபோ॒ ஜ்யோதீ॒ ரஸோ॒(அ)ம்ருதம்॒ ப்³ரஹ்ம॒ பூ⁴ர் பு⁴வ॒ஸ் ஸுவ॒ரோம் ॥
text.kannada:
ಓಂ ಭೂಃ । ಓಂ ಭುವಃ । ಓಗುಂ ಸುವಃ । ಓಂ ಮಹಃ । ಓಂ ಜನಃ । ಓಂ ತಪಃ । ಓಗುಂ ಸ॒ತ್ಯಂ ।
ಓಂ ತತ್ ಸ॑ವಿ॒ತುರ್ ವರೇ᳚ಣ್ಯಂ॒ ಭರ್ಗೋ॑ ದೇ॒ವಸ್ಯ॑ ಧೀಮಹಿ । ಧಿಯೋ॒ ಯೋ ನಃ॑ ಪ್ರಚೋ॒ದಯಾ᳚ತ್ ॥
ಓಂ ಆಪೋ॒ ಜ್ಯೋತೀ॒ ರಸೋ॒ಽಮೃತಂ॒ ಬ್ರಹ್ಮ॒ ಭೂರ್ ಭುವ॒ಸ್ ಸುವ॒ರೋಂ ॥
text.telugu:
ఓం భూః । ఓం భువః । ఓగుం సువః । ఓం మహః । ఓం జనః । ఓం తపః । ఓగుం స॒త్యం ।
ఓం తత్ స॑వి॒తుర్ వరే᳚ణ్యం॒ భర్గో॑ దే॒వస్య॑ ధీమహి । ధియో॒ యో నః॑ ప్రచో॒దయా᳚త్ ॥
ఓం ఆపో॒ జ్యోతీ॒ రసో॒ఽమృతం॒ బ్రహ్మ॒ భూర్ భువ॒స్ సువ॒రోం ॥
text.malayalam:
ഓം ഭൂഃ । ഓം ഭുവഃ । ഓഗും സുവഃ । ഓം മഹഃ । ഓം ജനഃ । ഓം തപഃ । ഓഗും സ॒ത്യം ।
ഓം തത് സ॑വി॒തുർ വരേ᳚ണ്യം॒ ഭർഗോ॑ ദേ॒വസ്യ॑ ധീമഹി । ധിയോ॒ യോ നഃ॑ പ്രചോ॒ദയാ᳚ത് ॥
ഓം ആപോ॒ ജ്യോതീ॒ രസോ॒ഽമൃതം॒ ബ്രഹ്മ॒ ഭൂർ ഭുവ॒സ് സുവ॒രോം ॥

items.action: prāṇāyāma as before (recite mentally holding the breath); then touch the right ear and take the saṅkalpa posture
items.meaning: Om — the seven realms; may we meditate upon that adorable light of the divine Creator, may He impel our intellect; He is the waters, light, flavour, immortality, Brahman, pervading the three worlds — Om.

text.iast: hariḥ oṃ tatsat | govinda govinda govinda | mamopātta samasta duritakṣaya dvārā śrī parameśvara prītyarthaṃ {kala} sandhyā sūryārghya pradānaṃ kariṣye ||
text.devanagari: हरिः ॐ तत्सत् । गोविन्द गोविन्द गोविन्द । ममोपात्त समस्त दुरितक्षय द्वारा श्री परमेश्वर प्रीत्यर्थं {kala} सन्ध्या सूर्यार्घ्य प्रदानं करिष्ये ॥
text.tamil: ஹரிஃ ௐ தத்ஸத் । கோ³விந்த³ கோ³விந்த³ கோ³விந்த³ । மமோபாத்த ஸமஸ்த து³ரிதக்ஷய த்³வாரா ஶ்ரீ பரமேஶ்வர ப்ரீத்யர்த²ம் {kala} ஸந்த்⁴யா ஸூர்யார்க்⁴ய ப்ரதா³னம் கரிஷ்யே ॥
text.kannada: ಹರಿಃ ಓಂ ತತ್ಸತ್ । ಗೋವಿಂದ ಗೋವಿಂದ ಗೋವಿಂದ । ಮಮೋಪಾತ್ತ ಸಮಸ್ತ ದುರಿತಕ್ಷಯ ದ್ವಾರಾ ಶ್ರೀ ಪರಮೇಶ್ವರ ಪ್ರೀತ್ಯರ್ಥಂ {kala} ಸಂಧ್ಯಾ ಸೂರ್ಯಾರ್ಘ್ಯ ಪ್ರದಾನಂ ಕರಿಷ್ಯೇ ॥

items.meaning: For the destruction of all my sins and to please the Supreme Lord, I now offer the {kalaEn} sandhyā libations of water to the Sun.

items.meaning: By the command of the Lord and to please Śrīman Nārāyaṇa, I now offer the {kalaEn} sandhyā libations of water (to the Sun).

text.iast: arghyapradāna mantrasya viśvāmitra ṛṣiḥ | devī gāyatrī chandaḥ | savitā devatā | arghyapradāne viniyogaḥ ||
text.devanagari: अर्घ्यप्रदान मन्त्रस्य विश्वामित्र ऋषिः । देवी गायत्री छन्दः । सविता देवता । अर्घ्यप्रदाने विनियोगः ॥
text.tamil: அர்க்⁴யப்ரதா³ன மந்த்ரஸ்ய விஶ்வாமித்ர ருஷிஃ । தே³வீ கா³யத்ரீ ச²ந்த³ஃ । ஸவிதா தே³வதா । அர்க்⁴யப்ரதா³னே விநியோக³ஃ ॥
text.kannada: ಅರ್ಘ್ಯಪ್ರದಾನ ಮಂತ್ರಸ್ಯ ವಿಶ್ವಾಮಿತ್ರ ಋಷಿಃ । ದೇವೀ ಗಾಯತ್ರೀ ಛಂದಃ । ಸವಿತಾ ದೇವತಾ । ಅರ್ಘ್ಯಪ್ರದಾನೇ ವಿನಿಯೋಗಃ ॥
text.telugu: అర్ఘ్యప్రదాన మంత్రస్య విశ్వామిత్ర ఋషిః । దేవీ గాయత్రీ ఛందః । సవితా దేవతా । అర్ఘ్యప్రదానే వినియోగః ॥
text.malayalam: അർഘ്യപ്രദാന മന്ത്രസ്യ വിശ്വാമിത്ര ഋഷിഃ । ദേവീ ഗായത്രീ ഛന്ദഃ । സവിതാ ദേവതാ । അർഘ്യപ്രദാനേ വിനിയോഗഃ ॥

items.action: nyāsa: touch head (ṛṣi), tip of nose (chandas), heart (devatā); then añjali (viniyoga)
items.meaning: Of the arghya mantra, Viśvāmitra is the seer, devī gāyatrī the metre, Savitṛ the deity; it is applied in the offering of arghya.

text.iast: oṃ bhūr bhuva̱s suva̍ḥ | tat sa̍vi̱tur vare̎ṇya̱ṃ bhargo̍ de̱vasya̍ dhīmahi | dhiyo̱ yo na̍ḥ praco̱dayā̎t ||
text.devanagari: ॐ भूर् भुव॒स् सुवः॑ । तत् स॑वि॒तुर् वरे᳚ण्यं॒ भर्गो॑ दे॒वस्य॑ धीमहि । धियो॒ यो नः॑ प्रचो॒दया᳚त् ॥
text.tamil: ௐ பூ⁴ர் பு⁴வ॒ஸ் ஸுவ॑ஃ । தத் ஸ॑வி॒துர் வரே᳚ண்யம்॒ ப⁴ர்கோ॑³ தே॒³வஸ்ய॑ தீ⁴மஹி । தி⁴யோ॒ யோ ந॑ஃ ப்ரசோ॒த³யா᳚த் ॥
text.kannada: ಓಂ ಭೂರ್ ಭುವ॒ಸ್ ಸುವಃ॑ । ತತ್ ಸ॑ವಿ॒ತುರ್ ವರೇ᳚ಣ್ಯಂ॒ ಭರ್ಗೋ॑ ದೇ॒ವಸ್ಯ॑ ಧೀಮಹಿ । ಧಿಯೋ॒ ಯೋ ನಃ॑ ಪ್ರಚೋ॒ದಯಾ᳚ತ್ ॥
text.telugu: ఓం భూర్ భువ॒స్ సువః॑ । తత్ స॑వి॒తుర్ వరే᳚ణ్యం॒ భర్గో॑ దే॒వస్య॑ ధీమహి । ధియో॒ యో నః॑ ప్రచో॒దయా᳚త్ ॥
text.malayalam: ഓം ഭൂർ ഭുവ॒സ് സുവഃ॑ । തത് സ॑വി॒തുർ വരേ᳚ണ്യം॒ ഭർഗോ॑ ദേ॒വസ്യ॑ ധീമഹി । ധിയോ॒ യോ നഃ॑ പ്രചോ॒ദയാ᳚ത് ॥

items.action: stand, water in the joined palms raised to the forehead; recite, rise on the heels looking at the sun and release the water from the fingertips — once per libation
items.meaning: Om, earth, atmosphere, heaven. We meditate upon that adorable light of the divine Savitṛ; may He impel our thoughts.

items.action: sandhya.pdf adds this after each libation
items.meaning: Om, salutations to the Sun — this is the libation.

items.text: Kidambi offers the noon arghya once, noting that some sampradāyas offer it twice; the Mumbai Smārta text and Chakravarthy give two; sandhya.pdf gives three at all three kālas.

steps.intro: If the sandhyā is being performed after the prescribed time (after sunrise in the morning, after sunset in the evening; at noon only in some sampradāyas — Kidambi), an extra fourth libation is offered as atonement. Prāṇāyāma, śrotrācamanam and the saṅkalpa posture; saṅkalpa; nyāsa; then, standing as before with water in the joined palms raised to the forehead, recite and release the water once, rising on the heels and looking towards the sun.

items.text: Prāṇāyāma as before (*oṃ bhūḥ … bhūr bhuvas suvarom*), touch the right ear, then the saṅkalpa posture.

items.meaning: Om — the seven realms. May we meditate upon that adorable light of the divine Savitṛ; may He impel our thoughts. Om — the seven realms.

title.en: Circling oneself; contemplation of the Sun as Brahman

steps.intro: Take a little water in the right palm and, reciting *oṃ bhūr bhuvas suvaḥ*, circle the hand around the head clockwise while turning yourself once clockwise on the spot, letting the water fall around you. Then, standing facing the sun with hands in añjali (Kaalai: after a prāṇāyāma), meditate on the Lord in the centre of the Sun and on the meaning of the sentence for a minute or two, eyes closed. Do not rush this.

items.action: circle the water around the head clockwise while turning yourself clockwise (ātma-pradakṣiṇam)
items.meaning: Om, earth, atmosphere, heaven.

items.action: hands in añjali; contemplate the Lord in the centre of the Sun
items.meaning: Yonder Sun is Brahman.

items.action: meditate for a while that you and Brahman are the same
items.meaning: Brahman indeed am I.

steps.intro: Sit in kukkuṭāsana and perform ācamanam again: swallow water three times with the three names, then touch the limbs with the twelve names.

items.action: pour a little water into the right palm and swallow it
items.meaning: Salutations to Acyuta, the unfallen one.
Salutations to Ananta, the infinite one.

items.action: again pour water and swallow; wash the hand and wipe the lips
items.meaning: Salutations to Govinda, protector of the world.

title.en: Libations to the planets and the twelve names

steps.intro: Sit in kukkuṭāsana holding the vessel between the thumb and index finger of the left hand; join both palms facing upwards. For each name pour water into the hollow of the joined palms, recite, and let the water flow out through the fingertips of both hands (deva-tīrtha) onto the ground or plate — like arghya but without rising on the heels. Smārtas offer to the nine grahas and then the twelve names; Śrī Vaiṣṇavas (Kidambi) to the twelve names only.

items.meaning: I satisfy Āditya, the Sun.
I satisfy Soma, the Moon.
I satisfy Aṅgāraka, Mars.
I satisfy Budha, Mercury.
I satisfy Bṛhaspati, Jupiter.
I satisfy Śukra, Venus.
I satisfy Śanaiścara, Saturn.
I satisfy Rāhu.
I satisfy Ketu.

items.action: pour water into the joined palms, recite, let it flow through the fingers
items.meaning: I satisfy Keśava.
I satisfy Nārāyaṇa.
I satisfy Mādhava.
I satisfy Govinda.
I satisfy Viṣṇu.
I satisfy Madhusūdana.
I satisfy Trivikrama.
I satisfy Vāmana.
I satisfy Śrīdhara.
I satisfy Hṛṣīkeśa.
I satisfy Padmanābha.
I satisfy Dāmodara. (The twelve names are the forms of Viṣṇu presiding over the twelve months.)

items.text: Then perform ācamanam (three sips and the twelve names).

items.action: one more offering of water from the palm
items.meaning: Om, That is the Truth — may this be an offering to Brahman.

title.en: Sprinkling the place of japa; the seat mantra

steps.intro: Sprinkle a little water on a clean spot for the japa with *oṃ bhūr bhuvas suvaḥ*. Sit (Kidambi: stand) in the sprinkled area facing east — west in the evening — and touch the ground. Nyāsa (head – nose – heart – añjali), then recite the seat mantra with hands in añjali. The Kaalai Smārta text adds a prayer to the earth to clear the spot of obstructing beings.

items.action: sprinkle water on the place where you will sit for japa
items.meaning: Om, earth, atmosphere, heaven.

items.meaning: O Mother Earth, by you the worlds are supported, and you, O Goddess, are supported by Viṣṇu. Support me too, O Goddess, and purify this seat.

title.en: Ācamanam at the start of the Uttarāṅgam

steps.intro: Several texts begin the Gāyatrī-japa portion (Uttarāṅgam) with a fresh ācamanam — sip water three times from the brāhma-tīrtha — followed by the Keśavādi aṅga-nyāsam as at the start; Smārta texts add the Gaṇapati dhyānam. Kidambi goes straight from the āsana mantra to prāṇāyāma and the japa saṅkalpam.

items.meaning: Salutations to Acyuta, the unfallen one.
Salutations to Ananta, the infinite one.
Salutations to Govinda, protector of the world.

items.text: Then touch the limbs with the twelve names *keśavāya namaḥ … dāmodarāya namaḥ* as in Aṅga-nyāsam.

ப்ரஸன்னவத³னம் த்⁴யாயேத் ஸர்வவிக்⁴னோபஶாந்தயே ॥
text.kannada:
ಶುಕ್ಲಾಂಬರಧರಂ ವಿಷ್ಣುಂ ಶಶಿವರ್ಣಂ ಚತುರ್ಭುಜಂ ।
ಪ್ರಸನ್ನವದನಂ ಧ್ಯಾಯೇತ್ ಸರ್ವವಿಘ್ನೋಪಶಾಂತಯೇ ॥
text.telugu:
శుక్లాంబరధరం విష్ణుం శశివర్ణం చతుర్భుజం ।
ప్రసన్నవదనం ధ్యాయేత్ సర్వవిఘ్నోపశాంతయే ॥
text.malayalam:
ശുക്ലാംബരധരം വിഷ്ണും ശശിവർണം ചതുർഭുജം ।
പ്രസന്നവദനം ധ്യായേത് സർവവിഘ്നോപശാന്തയേ ॥

items.action: gently tap the temples with the fists (some texts: five times, once after each word)
items.meaning: The all-pervading Lord is to be meditated upon for the removal of obstacles — clad in white garments, resplendent like the moon, four-armed and cheerful-faced.

steps.intro: Perform prāṇāyāma three times, touch the right ear, and take the saṅkalpa posture: left palm upturned on the right thigh, right palm over it (brahmāñjali). Recite the saṅkalpa for your tradition, naming the number of times you will recite the Gāyatrī. Then release the hands.

text.iast:
oṃ bhūḥ | oṃ bhuvaḥ | oguṃ suvaḥ | oṃ mahaḥ | oṃ janaḥ | oṃ tapaḥ | oguṃ satyam |
oṃ tat sa̍vi̱tur vare̎ṇyaṃ bhargo̍ de̱vasya̍ dhīmahi | dhiyo̱ yo na̍ḥ praco̱dayā̎t ||
oṃ āpo̱ jyotī̱ raso̱'mṛta̱ṃ brahma̱ bhūr bhuva̱s suva̱rom ||
text.devanagari:
ॐ भूः । ॐ भुवः । ओगुं सुवः । ॐ महः । ॐ जनः । ॐ तपः । ओगुं सत्यम् ।
ॐ तत् स॑वि॒तुर् वरे᳚ण्यं भर्गो॑ दे॒वस्य॑ धीमहि । धियो॒ यो नः॑ प्रचो॒दया᳚त् ॥
ॐ आपो॒ ज्योती॒ रसो॒ऽमृतं॒ ब्रह्म॒ भूर् भुव॒स् सुव॒रोम् ॥
text.tamil:
ௐ பூ⁴ஃ । ௐ பு⁴வஃ । ஓகு³ம் ஸுவஃ । ௐ மஹஃ । ௐ ஜனஃ । ௐ தபஃ । ஓகு³ம் ஸத்யம் ।
ௐ தத் ஸ॑வி॒துர் வரே᳚ண்யம் ப⁴ர்கோ॑³ தே॒³வஸ்ய॑ தீ⁴மஹி । தி⁴யோ॒ யோ ந॑ஃ ப்ரசோ॒த³யா᳚த் ॥
ௐ ஆபோ॒ ஜ்யோதீ॒ ரஸோ॒(அ)ம்ருதம்॒ ப்³ரஹ்ம॒ பூ⁴ர் பு⁴வ॒ஸ் ஸுவ॒ரோம் ॥
text.kannada:
ಓಂ ಭೂಃ । ಓಂ ಭುವಃ । ಓಗುಂ ಸುವಃ । ಓಂ ಮಹಃ । ಓಂ ಜನಃ । ಓಂ ತಪಃ । ಓಗುಂ ಸತ್ಯಂ ।
ಓಂ ತತ್ ಸ॑ವಿ॒ತುರ್ ವರೇ᳚ಣ್ಯಂ ಭರ್ಗೋ॑ ದೇ॒ವಸ್ಯ॑ ಧೀಮಹಿ । ಧಿಯೋ॒ ಯೋ ನಃ॑ ಪ್ರಚೋ॒ದಯಾ᳚ತ್ ॥
ಓಂ ಆಪೋ॒ ಜ್ಯೋತೀ॒ ರಸೋ॒ಽಮೃತಂ॒ ಬ್ರಹ್ಮ॒ ಭೂರ್ ಭುವ॒ಸ್ ಸುವ॒ರೋಂ ॥
text.telugu:
ఓం భూః । ఓం భువః । ఓగుం సువః । ఓం మహః । ఓం జనః । ఓం తపః । ఓగుం సత్యం ।
ఓం తత్ స॑వి॒తుర్ వరే᳚ణ్యం భర్గో॑ దే॒వస్య॑ ధీమహి । ధియో॒ యో నః॑ ప్రచో॒దయా᳚త్ ॥
ఓం ఆపో॒ జ్యోతీ॒ రసో॒ఽమృతం॒ బ్రహ్మ॒ భూర్ భువ॒స్ సువ॒రోం ॥
text.malayalam:
ഓം ഭൂഃ । ഓം ഭുവഃ । ഓഗും സുവഃ । ഓം മഹഃ । ഓം ജനഃ । ഓം തപഃ । ഓഗും സത്യം ।
ഓം തത് സ॑വി॒തുർ വരേ᳚ണ്യം ഭർഗോ॑ ദേ॒വസ്യ॑ ധീമഹി । ധിയോ॒ യോ നഃ॑ പ്രചോ॒ദയാ᳚ത് ॥
ഓം ആപോ॒ ജ്യോതീ॒ രസോ॒ഽമൃതം॒ ബ്രഹ്മ॒ ഭൂർ ഭുവ॒സ് സുവ॒രോം ॥

items.meaning: Om — the material world; Om — the realm of mind; Om — the realm of light; Om — the realm of vastness; Om — the realm of creative delight; Om — the realm of unobstructed will; Om — the realm of the highest Truth. May we meditate upon that adorable light of the divine Creator; may He impel our intellect. He is in the waters, in light, in flavour, in the nectar of immortality, and pervades the three realms — physical, mental and spiritual. All this is denoted by the Praṇava.

text.iast: hariḥ oṃ tatsat | govinda govinda govinda | mamopātta samasta duritakṣaya dvārā śrī parameśvara prītyarthaṃ {kala} sandhyā {japaCount} vāraṃ gāyatrī mahāmantra japaṃ kariṣye ||
text.devanagari: हरिः ॐ तत्सत् । गोविन्द गोविन्द गोविन्द । ममोपात्त समस्त दुरितक्षय द्वारा श्री परमेश्वर प्रीत्यर्थं {kala} सन्ध्या {japaCount} वारं गायत्री महामन्त्र जपं करिष्ये ॥
text.tamil: ஹரிஃ ௐ தத்ஸத் । கோ³விந்த³ கோ³விந்த³ கோ³விந்த³ । மமோபாத்த ஸமஸ்த து³ரிதக்ஷய த்³வாரா ஶ்ரீ பரமேஶ்வர ப்ரீத்யர்த²ம் {kala} ஸந்த்⁴யா {japaCount} வாரம் கா³யத்ரீ மஹாமந்த்ர ஜபம் கரிஷ்யே ॥
text.kannada: ಹರಿಃ ಓಂ ತತ್ಸತ್ । ಗೋವಿಂದ ಗೋವಿಂದ ಗೋವಿಂದ । ಮಮೋಪಾತ್ತ ಸಮಸ್ತ ದುರಿತಕ್ಷಯ ದ್ವಾರಾ ಶ್ರೀ ಪರಮೇಶ್ವರ ಪ್ರೀತ್ಯರ್ಥಂ {kala} ಸಂಧ್ಯಾ {japaCount} ವಾರಂ ಗಾಯತ್ರೀ ಮಹಾಮಂತ್ರ ಜಪಂ ಕರಿಷ್ಯೇ ॥
text.telugu: హరిః ఓం తత్సత్ । గోవింద గోవింద గోవింద । మమోపాత్త సమస్త దురితక్షయ ద్వారా శ్రీ పరమేశ్వర ప్రీత్యర్థం {kala} సంధ్యా {japaCount} వారం గాయత్రీ మహామంత్ర జపం కరిష్యే ॥
text.malayalam: ഹരിഃ ഓം തത്സത് । ഗോവിന്ദ ഗോവിന്ദ ഗോവിന്ദ । മമോപാത്ത സമസ്ത ദുരിതക്ഷയ ദ്വാരാ ശ്രീ പരമേശ്വര പ്രീത്യർഥം {kala} സന്ധ്യാ {japaCount} വാരം ഗായത്രീ മഹാമന്ത്ര ജപം കരിഷ്യേ ॥

items.meaning: For the absolution of all my sins and to invoke the grace of the Supreme Lord, I now, in the course of my {kalaEn} sandhyā, perform the recitation of the great Gāyatrī mantra {japaCount} times.

text.tamil: ஹரிஃ ௐ தத்ஸத் । கோ³விந்த³ கோ³விந்த³ கோ³விந்த³ । ஶ்ரீ ப⁴க³வதா³ஜ்ஞயா ஶ்ரீமந்நாராயண ப்ரீத்யர்த²ம் {kala} ஸந்த்⁴யா {japaCount} வாரம் கா³யத்ரீ மஹாமந்த்ர ஜபம் கரிஷ்யே ॥
